description: This file defines the function git_pread, which provides a pread-like behavior by manually managing file offsets using lseek and read_in_full.

methods.name: ssize_t git_pread(int fd,void * buf,size_t count,off_t offset)
methods.description: Reads 'count' bytes from file descriptor 'fd' at offset 'offset' into 'buf', restoring the file position after reading.
